title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 19: Jonathan's plea, Michal's rescue of David and Saul among the prophets at Naioth.

questions.text: What did Saul tell Jonathan and all his servants to do?
questions.explanation: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David.

questions.text: What did Saul swear after he listened to Jonathan?
questions.explanation: Saul swore, "As Yahweh lives, he shall not be put to death."

answers.text: "As Yahweh lives, he shall not be put to death."
"David shall never again come before me."

questions.text: Where did Saul's spear end up when David slipped away?
questions.explanation: Saul sought to pin David to the wall, but David slipped away, and Saul stuck the spear into the wall.

answers.text: In the doorpost of the gate

questions.text: How did Michal help David escape?
questions.explanation: Michal let David down through the window, and he went away, fled and escaped.

answers.text: She hid him in a large jar
She let him down through the window
She dressed him as a servant
She led him out by a secret tunnel

questions.text: What did Michal lay in the bed?
questions.explanation: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, with a pillow of goats' hair at its head, and covered it with clothes.

questions.text: What did Michal tell Saul's messengers when they came to take David?
questions.explanation: When Saul sent messengers to take David, Michal said, "He is sick."

questions.text: What did Michal claim David had said to her?
questions.explanation: Michal answered Saul that David had said, "Let me go! Why should I kill you?"

answers.text: "Tell your father I am his servant."
"Let me go! Why should I kill you?"
"Yahweh will judge between Saul and me."

questions.text: To whom did David flee after he escaped?
questions.explanation: David fled and came to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him.

questions.text: What happened to Saul's messengers when they saw the company of the prophets?
questions.explanation: God's Spirit came on Saul's messengers, and they also prophesied.
He prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and night; therefore they say, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"

answers.text: "Is Saul also a son of Jesse?"
